about: The dependency sources and license expressions `cargo xtask ci licenses` accepts, for the workspace's Cargo.lock and the CI browser fixture's (tools/xtask/ci-browser-fixture/Cargo.lock). Each expression is matched exactly as cargo metadata reports a dependency's `license` field. Reviewed for infra-m0.2 on 2026-10-14 against every dependency of both lockfiles; a new expression is added only after the same review.

expressions.reviewed: either permissive license, at our choice
the same choice, written in the other order
the older slash form of the same choice
public-domain dedication or MIT, at our choice
the older slash form of the same choice
unicode-ident: MIT or Apache-2.0 for the code, plus the permissive Unicode-3.0 license for its Unicode data tables
miniz_oxide 0.8.9 (calc-doc's DEFLATE decoder, cdoc-m1.1, 2026-10-19): any of three permissive licenses, at our choice; we take MIT
adler2 2.0.1 (miniz_oxide's one non-optional dependency, cdoc-m1.1, 2026-10-19): any of three permissive licenses, at our choice; we take MIT
